name: Whirlpool
legalEntityNote: Whirlpool is a consumer appliance brand owned by Whirlpool Corporation. Regional Whirlpool companies operate retained markets, while Beko Europe B.V. uses the Whirlpool brand under a licence limited to specified European jurisdictions. The legal seller, manufacturer, importer and warrantor vary by product and country.

ownership.summary: Whirlpool Corporation owns the Whirlpool consumer brand and includes it in its current global portfolio. Beko Europe B.V. operates Whirlpool-branded major appliances under a licence limited to specified European jurisdictions. Beko B.V. acquired Whirlpool Corporation's remaining 25% Beko Europe interest in June 2026, but the trademark licence stayed in force; Beko Europe is a licensee, not the global Whirlpool brand owner.

leadership.name: Marc Bitzer
leadership.role: Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, Whirlpool Corporation
leadership.context: Named in Whirlpool Corporation's 2025 Annual Report; this is corporate leadership rather than a separate Whirlpool-brand legal entity.

productPortfolio.name: Laundry appliances
productPortfolio.positioning: Whirlpool offers washers, dryers, laundry centers and all-in-one formats with regional feature and capacity differences.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Verify model capacity, voltage, installation, app region, origin, parts and warranty for the destination market.

productPortfolio.name: Refrigeration and kitchen appliances
productPortfolio.positioning: The brand spans refrigerators, cooking appliances, dishwashers and related major-appliance categories in retained and licensed markets.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Confirm whether Whirlpool Corporation, Beko Europe or another regional company is the legal seller and service provider.

productPortfolio.name: Licensed home-comfort and water products
productPortfolio.positioning: Whirlpool Corporation lists selected licensed categories including air purifiers, compact refrigeration, dehumidification, room air, water heating and filtration.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Request the licensee, category scope, territory, manufacturer and warranty rather than assuming Whirlpool Corporation made the product.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Whirlpool Corporation reported that 80% of the major appliances it sold in the United States came from its U.S. factories in 2025.
manufacturingSupplyChain.scope: Whirlpool Corporation U.S. major-appliance sales in 2025
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Use the exact SKU label and origin documents; the portfolio statistic does not identify a model's plant.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Beko Europe reports an 11-site European production network supporting its multi-brand operation.
manufacturingSupplyChain.scope: Beko Europe regional industrial network, including owned and licensed brands
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Require a factory declaration for the exact Whirlpool-branded model before naming a Beko Europe plant.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Whirlpool Corporation operates licensed product categories outside its core major-appliance chain.
manufacturingSupplyChain.scope: Categories listed on the official Whirlpool Corporation licensing page
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Identify the licensee, legal manufacturer, factory and warranty provider for each licensed category.

marketsChannels.evidence: Whirlpool Corporation reports principal major-appliance businesses in North America and Latin America and retains the Whirlpool brand in its portfolio.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Identify the regional Whirlpool legal entity, authorized channel and local warranty for the destination country.

marketsChannels.evidence: Beko Europe lists Whirlpool among brands used under a licence limited to certain jurisdictions.
marketsChannels.scope: Specified European markets and licensed product scope
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm that the seller's authorization and the product's trademark licence cover the destination market.

marketsChannels.evidence: Whirlpool products are sold through direct sites, retailers, distributors, builders and professional channels, with assortment and terms varying by region.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Verify territory, ecommerce rights, installation, spare parts, returns and warranty obligations in the contract.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: Whirlpool combines a strong Americas-centered owner-manufacturer platform with licensed European brand operation. The regional model broadens reach but makes territory, licence, legal seller and model-level factory verification essential for buyers.

developments.title: Beko completes acquisition of Whirlpool's Beko Europe stake
developments.summary: The regulatory completion entry records Beko B.V.'s acquisition of Whirlpool EMEA Holdings LLC's 25% interest, taking Beko Europe ownership to 100% while the trademark licence remained in force.

developments.title: Whirlpool and Arçelik close the EMEA transaction
developments.summary: Whirlpool Corporation contributed its European major-appliance business to Beko Europe and retained its EMEA KitchenAid business.

developments.title: Company origins
developments.summary: Whirlpool Corporation traces its history to 1911 and reports more than a century in kitchen and laundry appliances.
